last_observed_checkpoint.meaning: The reporter reached the wrapper immediately before the original machine_startup call in arm_init. This is the final instrumented checkpoint in the delivered candidate.

attribution.basis: User-supplied display label matches the delivered platform-trace candidate.

source_interpretation: A stationary final checkpoint is compatible with later uninstrumented execution as well as a later stall; it does not locate a fault.
The original machine_startup calls machine_conf and then tail-transfers to kernel_bootstrap; it does not return normally.
The ramoops initialization function may return with an inactive zone on validation failure, so an earlier returned checkpoint alone does not establish active log storage.

Pinned XNU already supports startup_debug=1. It enables actual kprintf startup-stage and initializer-address messages after KPRINTF startup, which can feed the existing ramoops console path without added checkpoint replay delays.
The exact CDC startup remains later in bsd_init after IOKitInitializeTime and before vfsinit. No current report establishes that execution reached this call.
